roles.name: demo_session
roles.note: No credentials observed in any source run. scope.json does not set authentication_required, so authentication is out of scope. All state-changing endpoints are reachable without credentials against the demo fixture.

semantic_ui_capture.no_relevant_rules_reason: Cross-flow aggregate: this run declares mode=cross_flow and performs no new browser observation, so per the cross-flow contract it keeps observed_ui_rules empty and does not copy or upgrade source rules. The verified source observed-UI rules (price/UIR-001, price/UIR-002, cancel/UIR-001, cancel/UIR-002, cancel/UIR-003, refund/UIR-001, refund/UIR-002) remain authoritative in each source state map and are referenced by ID from cross_flow_candidates.json, not re-derived here.

state_map.observed_ui_rules_note: Cross-flow aggregate: source observed-UI rules remain in cross_flow_inputs.json and are referenced by ID from cross_flow_candidates.json. They are not copied or upgraded into this aggregate map. Verified source rules: price/UIR-001, price/UIR-002, cancel/UIR-001, cancel/UIR-002, cancel/UIR-003, refund/UIR-001, refund/UIR-002.

critical_endpoints.why: Observed in price source (HAR entry 1): issues a $30 payout on a delivered order, raising totalReturned from 0 to 30. Agent inference (unverified): composed with cancel or refund completion from other sources, the $30 may stack past originalAmount=100.

Observed in cancel source (HAR entry 1): issues a $100 cancellation reimbursement, raising totalReturned from 0 to 100. Agent inference (unverified): composed with price adjustment or refund completion from other sources, a second payout may raise totalReturned past 100.

Observed in refund source (HAR entry 1): creates a $100 refund request (requestedAmount=100, status=pending). Agent inference (unverified): composed with a prior price adjustment, the pending $100 refund plus the already-paid $30 adjustment may exceed originalAmount=100 once complete is called.

Observed in refund source (HAR entry 2): completes a pending $100 refund, raising totalReturned from 0 to 100. Highest financial impact per action. Agent inference (unverified): composed with a prior price adjustment or a prior cancellation, the $100 refund completion may push totalReturned past originalAmount=100.

State reader used for before/after captures in all sources. Exposes order.totalReturned, order.originalAmount, order.availableActions and all payout sub-objects. Read-only; not an attack target but required to verify invariants.

conflicting_action_pairs.rule: Cancellation reimbursement and completed refund must not both reimburse the same order beyond originalAmount=100.

conflicting_action_pairs.rule: No composed sequence of price adjustment, cancellation reimbursement, and completed refund may raise totalReturned above originalAmount=100.

proposal.correction_notes: Validator error (attempt 1): 'An empty observed_ui_rules array needs a no-relevant-rules reason'. Fix: added a non-empty string to semantic_ui_capture.no_relevant_rules_reason, which is the required field for an empty observed_ui_rules array once semantic capture has succeeded. This map is a cross-flow aggregate (analysis_source=CROSS_FLOW, semantic_ui_capture.mode=cross_flow, status=succeeded), and the cross-flow contract requires observed_ui_rules to stay empty and instead reference verified source rules by ID; the new reason states exactly that. This is a non-rule schema-field addition only: no rule IDs, fact IDs, claimed text, rule statements, or inferences were added, removed, or weakened (the array was already empty and remains empty). All other fields — transitions, roles, semantic_ui_capture (existing fields), critical_endpoints, conflicting_action_pairs, observed_ui_rules_note, source_runs, and source_state_counts — are preserved verbatim. Evidence: semantic_ui_capture.status='succeeded', mode='cross_flow', source_runs=['price','cancel','refund'], and the pre-existing observed_ui_rules_note confirming the 7 verified source rules live in the per-source state maps and are referenced by ID, not copied into this aggregate.
